title: 第24章 符文入体第25章 先发制人
content_zh:
杀气笼罩，危险即至！
电闪火石之间，陆沉预判到是谁出手暗算！
他手指动了。
黑袍人也动了。
黑袍人气息全开，真元境三重！
“回风拳！”
一个拳头砸出，力重三万斤，拳风急湍，空气嗡鸣！
“炎阳指！”
一指点出，指力四万，所到之处，爆响不断！
啪！
黑袍人的拳头被点爆，血肉横飞。
指力去势未尽，继续点爆下去，直接把黑袍人整条手臂废得渣都不剩。
陆沉伸手一探，将黑袍人的面罩撕下，露出一张熟悉又狰狞的嘴脸。
陆正宁！
“你……你的力量竟然比我还大。”
陆正宁惊骇欲绝，这才过了几天啊，陆沉竟然迈入了真元境，还在复杂的环境下感知他的偷袭，让他功亏一篑，真是怪胎啊！
“陆正宁，你以为还能离开此地吗”
陆沉见陆正宁想逃跑，身形一闪，截住他的退路。
“陆正宁，你这个陆家叛贼，竟敢偷袭少主，纳命来！”
大长老怒气冲冲的奔出，几个兔起鹘落，眨眼便到了跟前。

“大长老，饶命啊。”
陆正宁惊恐的叫道，他偷袭失败，一条手臂被毁，哪里是大长老的对手
大长老不容分说，直接一掌拍出，正中陆正宁的脑门。
陆正宁当场倒下，气绝身亡。
考场剧变，让现场一阵沉默。
既然是陆家的家事，外人就不好过问了。
再者，也无人敢去追究陆正宁是怎么混进来的
考场的工作人员，都是城主府的人，天晓得陆正宁有没有跟城主府有关
只有相关人等才心知肚明，但招生大典上，没必要点破。
陆沉虽然斩了陆正宁，却被九道光箭全部射中，主考官也只能如此宣布：“一道光箭也没躲过，淘……”
“等等！”
飞霞门的老妪突然打断主考官，“此子躲过了一场精心策划的暗算，感知能力很强，让他晋级！”
“此子有斩杀真元境三重的实力，可以晋级。”
沙长老看向陆沉，不住点头认可。
紫云门长老倒没说什么，反正陆沉是囊中之物，他要把陆沉带回去，送入紫云丹院赚人情。
content_en:
Murderous aura surrounds us, and danger is imminent!
In the midst of lightning and flint, Lu Chen predicted who was plotting the plot!
His fingers moved.
The man in black robe also moved.
The black-robed man's aura is fully open, and he is at the third level of the True Yuan Realm!
"Returning Fist!"
A fist was punched out, weighing 30,000 kilograms, the wind of the punch was turbulent, and the air buzzed!
"Fire Yang Finger!"
With one finger pointing, the finger force is 40,000, and wherever it goes, there will be constant explosions!
Snap!
The fist of the man in black robe was exploded, and blood and flesh flew everywhere.
Before the force of the fingers was used to castrate it, he continued to explode, directly destroying the entire arm of the man in black robe until nothing was left.
Lu Chen reached out and tore off the mask of the man in black robe, revealing a familiar and ferocious face.
Lu Zhengning!
"You...you are actually stronger than me."
Lu Zhengning was horrified. Just a few days later, Lu Chen actually entered the True Yuan realm and sensed his sneak attack in a complicated environment, causing him to fail. What a freak!
"Lu Zhengning, do you think you can leave this place?"
When Lu Chen saw Lu Zhengning trying to escape, he stepped out of the way and blocked his retreat.
"Lu Zhengning, you, a traitor to the Lu family, dare to sneak attack on the young master, you will die!"
The great elder ran out angrily, and a few rabbits and falcons arrived in front of him in the blink of an eye.
"Great Elder, please spare my life."
Lu Zhengning shouted in horror. His sneak attack failed and one of his arms was destroyed. How could he be the great elder's opponent?
The Great Elder didn't allow any further explanation, and directly struck out with a palm, hitting Lu Zhengning's forehead.
Lu Zhengning fell down on the spot and died.
The dramatic changes in the examination room left the scene silent for a while.
Since it is a family matter of the Lu family, it is not easy for outsiders to interfere.
Furthermore, no one dared to investigate how Lu Zhengning got in.
The staff in the examination room are all people from the City Lord's Mansion. God knows if Lu Zhengning is related to the City Lord's Mansion.
Only the relevant people know it, but there is no need to reveal it at the admissions ceremony.
Although Lu Chen killed Lu Zhengning, he was hit by all nine light arrows. The examiner could only declare: "Not a single light arrow escaped, Tao..."
"Wait!"
The old woman from Feixiamen suddenly interrupted the examiner, "This boy escaped a well-planned assassination. His perceptive ability is very strong, let him advance!"
"This boy has the strength to kill the third level of the True Yuan Realm and can be promoted."
Elder Sha looked at Lu Chen and nodded in approval.
The elder of Ziyun Sect didn't say anything. Anyway, Lu Chen was the one in the bag. He wanted to take Lu Chen back and send him to Ziyun Danyuan to earn favors.
